doubt.C96920: With the network off, clicking Tech View did not switch the display: the whole Work Orders area was replaced by "Something went wrong loading this section" with a Retry button and a red "Part of the page failed to load. Your connection may have dropped." message, the switcher disappeared and List could not be clicked. The other two points held: after reconnecting and refreshing the page opened in Board View, and Tech View chosen online was kept after the next refresh. Why I do not call it Failed: the screen part that draws Tech View had to be downloaded while offline (that download is what failed), and staging was redeployed during this run (app version v26.40.17-ddb9ba1 at 17:40, v26.40.17-a5c4210 by 18:05; this check ran at 17:53), which would make the browser fetch fresh files instead of using copies it already had. A person following the case on a stable build may well have that part already in the browser. Re-run on a stable build, by hand or with the page loaded once in Tech View before going offline, and only then decide.
